newsitem.title: MEXICO: Conservative opposition leads Mexico City poll.
newsitem.headline: Conservative opposition leads Mexico City poll.

text.p: The conservative opposition National Action Party (PAN) has maintained its lead leading up to next year's first election for governor of Mexico City, according to a poll released on Thursday.
The poll of 600 Mexico City residents in October was conducted by Indemerc Louis Harris. The PAN has held a solid lead since the poll began last November.
The PAN scored 37 percent, up from 36 percent in August and far ahead of the leftist opposition Democratic Revolution Party (PRD) with 22 percent, Indemerc Louis Harris said.
The PRD, however, improved four percentage points from the August poll.
As it has since April, the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) trailed, this time with 12 percent, down from 13 percent from August.
None of the parities have nominated a candidate yet.
